about_the_game:
Experience a Different Typing Experience

WildType turns boring daily typing into a visual enjoyment. When you type, various dynamic effects will bloom on the screen, bringing a unique "wild" style to your work or creative process. Say goodbye to monotony and make every tapping dynamic.

Improve your typing skills

In addition to being a typing tool for daily use, WildType also provides a dedicated "speed mode" and "practice mode".

With the built-in practice content, you can systematically train your fingering and gradually improve your typing speed and accuracy.

Current core features:

  • Real-time visual effect feedback

  • Supports daily text input

  • Speed ​​mode provides real-time speed feedback

  • Basic typing practice mode

  • Vim-like motions to improve input movements

  • Built-in Chinese pinyin input method

We hope that WildType can be an interesting companion for your work and typing practice!
